1. Introduction

Welcome to HDR Media Solutions.

These Terms of Service govern your access to and use of the HDR Media Solutions website at https://hdrmediasolutions.co.za and the general terms applicable to our services.

HDR Media Solutions (Pty) Ltd (“HDR Media Solutions”, “we”, “us” or “our”) is a South African media and marketing company providing professional media production and related creative services.

By accessing or using our website, you agree to these terms to the extent applicable to your use. If you do not agree, please discontinue use of the website.

Where you engage our services, a separate quotation, proposal, booking confirmation or written service agreement may establish additional contractual terms.

3. Our Services

HDR Media Solutions offers professional media, production and marketing services, including:

  • Photography and event photography.
  • Videography and commercial video production.
  • Promotional videos and branded content.
  • Drone photography and aerial videography.
  • Live streaming and multicamera productions.
  • Audiovisual production and technical event support.
  • Social media content creation and management.
  • Digital marketing, advertising and campaign support.
  • Other related creative and media services.

Service availability, specifications, pricing and deliverables depend on the requirements of each project and will be confirmed in the applicable quotation or agreement.

Information displayed on our website is provided for general information and portfolio purposes. It does not constitute a binding offer to provide a particular service at a particular price or on a particular date.

4. Enquiries and Bookings

Submitting an enquiry through our website does not constitute a confirmed booking or create an obligation to purchase services.

A booking will be confirmed in accordance with the acceptance requirements specified in the relevant quotation, proposal or service agreement.

Depending on the project, confirmation may require written acceptance, payment of a deposit or completion of other agreed booking requirements.

Clients are responsible for providing accurate project information, including event dates, venues, deliverables, access requirements and any relevant production restrictions.

HDR Media Solutions reserves the right to decline a proposed engagement, subject to applicable law and any existing contractual obligations.

5. Quotations and Pricing

Project pricing will be communicated through quotations, proposals or written agreements.

Unless otherwise specified:

  • Prices are quoted in South African rand (ZAR).
  • Quotations are valid for the period stated in the quotation.
  • VAT will be identified where applicable.
  • Travel, accommodation, permits, additional crew, equipment hire, overtime and third-party expenses will be addressed in the quotation where relevant.
  • Changes to the agreed project scope may require revised pricing and written approval.

Any additional charges must be communicated and agreed where required by the applicable agreement or law.

A quotation should clearly identify the agreed services, deliverables, payment arrangements and any important exclusions.

6. Payments

Payment terms, deposits, instalments and final payment deadlines will be specified in the applicable quotation or service agreement.

Clients agree to pay amounts properly due under the agreed terms.

Where lawful and contractually agreed, failure to make a required payment may result in work being paused, delivery being delayed or a booking being cancelled after appropriate notice and subject to applicable law.

Any interest, collection costs or other late-payment charges must be lawfully recoverable and properly disclosed where required.

Nothing in this section permits HDR Media Solutions to disregard applicable consumer rights or contractual obligations.

7. Cancellations and Rescheduling

Clients wishing to cancel or reschedule a confirmed booking should notify HDR Media Solutions in writing as soon as reasonably possible.

The cancellation terms applicable to a project will be set out in the relevant quotation or service agreement.

Where permitted by law, cancellation charges may reflect work already completed, reasonable costs incurred, non-refundable third-party commitments and other properly disclosed contractual charges.

Refunds and cancellation rights will be determined in accordance with the applicable agreement and South African law, including the Consumer Protection Act 68 of 2008 where it applies.

Nothing in these terms automatically makes every deposit non-refundable or removes a consumer's statutory right to cancel where such a right exists.

8. Project Scope, Delivery and Revisions

The scope of work, deliverables, formats, revision allowance and expected delivery dates will be agreed in writing.

Requests that fall outside the agreed scope may require additional fees, subject to appropriate agreement.

Clients are expected to provide feedback, approvals, access and materials within agreed timeframes.

Delays caused by late approvals, incomplete information, venue restrictions, adverse weather, technical failures or other circumstances may affect delivery schedules.

HDR Media Solutions will take reasonable steps to communicate material delays and discuss appropriate alternatives.

Unless expressly included in the agreement, unedited footage, original project files, additional photographs, unused material and working files are not automatically included in the final deliverables.

9. Copyright and Intellectual Property

Intellectual property rights in photographs, videos, edits, graphics, creative concepts and other original materials produced by HDR Media Solutions will be governed by applicable South African law and the relevant project agreement.

Unless otherwise agreed in writing, paying for a project does not automatically transfer ownership of all intellectual property rights to the client.

The client receives only the licence or rights expressly granted in the applicable agreement.

Clients may not reproduce, resell, sublicense, distribute or commercially exploit materials beyond the agreed permissions without the necessary authorisation.

Third-party materials, including music, stock footage, fonts and licensed assets, remain subject to their respective licence conditions.

Clients retain their rights in materials they supply to HDR Media Solutions and must ensure that they have the necessary rights and permissions for the intended use of those materials.

All intellectual property arrangements remain subject to applicable copyright legislation and any rights that cannot lawfully be excluded.

10. Portfolio and Promotional Use

HDR Media Solutions may showcase completed work on its website, social media channels, showreels, proposals and other promotional materials only where the necessary permission has been obtained.

Permission may be recorded in a project agreement, release form or separate written authorisation.

Clients should communicate confidentiality requirements, publication embargoes and restrictions on promotional use before the relevant material is published.

Any use of identifiable individuals, confidential material or third-party intellectual property must comply with applicable permissions and legal requirements.

11. Client Responsibilities

Clients agree to:

  • Provide accurate project information.
  • Obtain permissions and access approvals allocated to them under the project agreement.
  • Ensure they have the necessary rights to materials supplied to us.
  • Cooperate reasonably during production.
  • Communicate relevant venue rules, safety requirements and restrictions.
  • Review and approve deliverables within agreed timeframes.

HDR Media Solutions remains responsible for its own legal obligations and for obtaining any permissions specifically allocated to it under the applicable agreement.

12. Drone Services and Live Streaming

Drone operations and live-streaming services are subject to applicable laws, permissions, weather conditions, venue restrictions, connectivity and technical limitations.

HDR Media Solutions will undertake drone operations in accordance with applicable aviation requirements and permissions.

Live streaming may depend on internet connectivity, third-party platforms, power availability, venue infrastructure and other factors outside our reasonable control.

We will take reasonable steps to plan and deliver these services in accordance with the agreed scope. However, uninterrupted streaming, platform availability and operation in unsuitable weather or prohibited airspace cannot be guaranteed.

Where a material technical or operational issue arises, we will take reasonable steps to communicate the issue and discuss practical alternatives.

Neither party will be responsible for a delay or failure to perform to the extent that it results from circumstances beyond its reasonable control, including severe weather, natural disasters, public emergencies, government restrictions, venue closures or widespread infrastructure failures.

The affected party should notify the other party as soon as reasonably practicable and take reasonable steps to minimise the impact.
